chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The calamity of the lineage is the pride and the self-important'.
ai.seo_question: What is the main defect of noble lineage according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia ethical tradition, this hadith from al-Kafi distinguishes between the inherent merit of lineage and the moral corruption of pride, warning that 'hasab' (lineage) becomes a liability when accompanied by 'ujb' (self-conceit). It reflects the Imams' emphasis on internal character over external status, a key theme in their teachings on humility. This serves as a practical reminder that noble ancestry requires corresponding noble conduct to remain a source of honor rather than a cause of spiritual downfall.
